title: EXPERIMENT: cached-route work budget 500 -> 2000 (Remastered CE parity)
description: Navigation update FUN_103aac30 services the pending cached-route list (Pathfinder+0x148, next +0x1C) FIFO and stops after the first request once work counter Pathfinder+0x470 reaches 500. Remastered CE raised the equivalent limit to 2000, cutting siege lock-ups from ~85 s to 0-3 s without removing them. Kept disabled so the invalidation experiment can be measured on its own; enable to A/B.
